title: Zemsky Sobor Elects 16-Year-Old Michael Romanov Tsar
dek: On 3 March 1613 an assembly of the realm, meeting in the Kremlin after the Poles were driven out, chooses Michael Romanov as tsar and ends the Time of Troubles.
body: The assembly first ruled out every foreign candidate. Accounts differ on whether it then chose Michael freely or under pressure from the Cossacks in Moscow.

panels.label: The Official Account Said
panels.text: Romanov-era and Soviet historians said the Sobor chose freely, voicing the wish of most Russians, and turned to a kinsman of Feodor I, the last tsar of the old line.

panels.label: The Critics Said
panels.text: Critics said Cossacks in Moscow forced Michael on boyars who had left him off their list, and that his backers wanted a young tsar they could steer.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Both sides trace the Romanov throne to 1613; at stake is whether it rested on the consent of the land, or on Cossack pressure and a boyar bet on a pliant boy.
